title: Rosemary Beach: Lagniappe Cottage in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Lagniappe Cottage in Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Lagniappe Cottage is a sanctuary of refinement, thoughtfully crafted to embrace the essence of Charleston-inspired architecture on Florida's luxurious Gulf Coast. Nestled in a more peaceful corner of the Rosemary Beach community, this private retreat is an ideal choice for up to 8 guests seeking an exclusive experience. This Cottage is only a short walk away from the community with a boardwalk adjacent to the residence that leads directly to Walkover B near the Eastern Green. For those also wanting amenities closer to their residence, the outdoor area features a shaded porch with elegant white columns supporting a balcony that overlooks a private pool.

Inside the home, you will be greeted by a foyer area with a grand winding staircase. On this level is a primary bedroom with direct access to the residence's private courtyard. This room boasts a private on-suite bathroom with double vanities and a shower. Just across the hall is a coastal themed bunked room with double twin stacked beds. French doors in this room make it especially easy for tired little ones to climb into bed after spending time at the nearby community park. This room as well has access to a half bath, a laundry room, and walk-in shower with direct access to the courtyard.

Ascend the staircase to a room adorned with beautiful French doors. Not only do these doors lead to a spacious balcony, but they are also perfect for allowing the fresh coastal breeze inside the home. The kitchen features modern stainless-steel appliances and white granite countertops, creating a sleek interior. Additionally, this space has access to its own private balcony, which makes it an ideal spot to wind down after dinner. The kitchen flows into a formal dining area with a view of the central winding staircase. On the other side of the floor, a spacious living area, equipped with a flatscreen TV, is ideal for a family movie night.

The third floor is the epitome of exclusivity with the entire floor servicing a junior master. This suite features a king bed beneath a charming cottage-style vaulted ceiling. On this floor, you will also find a private full bathroom equipped with a separate shower and tub.

Discover the perfect blend of elegance and relaxation at Lagniappe Cottage, where comfort and elegance meet the allure of coastal living.

Pool may be heated October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee.

Garage parking for one vehicle.
